title: Michael Bublé and Drew Scott strive for hockey glory in Prime Video docuseries 'Hometown Giants,' coming October 16
summary: Watch the trailer for the new Prime Video series about Vancouver Giants junior hockey players chasing NHL dreams.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- All six episodes of docuseries


Hometown Giants


are out now on Prime Video worldwide.


- The series features Vancouver Giants co-owners Michael Bublé and Drew Scott.


- It follows junior hockey players chasing NHL dreams while navigating life off the ice.


---


Highly anticipated new hockey docuseries


Hometown Giants


is streaming now on Prime Video.


The show takes viewers inside the high-stakes world of major junior hockey, following global music icon Michael Bublé and TV personality/entrepreneur Drew Scott as part-owners of the Western Hockey League's Vancouver Giants.


[‘Off Campus’ Season 2: Everything to know about the Prime Video show’s return](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/off-campus-hockey-series-prime-video)


Based on the best-selling books by Elle Kennedy, Season 2 will spotlight the romance between Allie and Dean.


Out now on Prime Video globally, the series blends elite-level competition with deeply personal coming-of-age stories. Here's everything you need to know.


## What is 'Hometown Giants' about?


Hometown Giants


follows the Vancouver Giants franchise during the 2025-26 season as owners Bublé and Scott set out to restore a team that hasn't won a championship since 2007.


With a new coach and General Manager leading the way, the series captures the bold front-office decisions, roster-shaping trades, and high-pressure moments that define a season on the edge.


But for the players, hockey is only part of the story. They're teenagers living away from home, finishing high school, navigating first relationships, and chasing NHL dreams they've built their lives around—even though only a few will ever make it.


## What happens during this season of 'Hometown Giants'?


Rookies adjust to the speed and intensity of major junior hockey while veterans fight for their place.


A grueling 15-day road trip tests the Giants on and off the ice. And as the trade deadline looms, top prospect Ryan Lin faces the spotlight, Torretto Marrelli fights to stay, and the team makes season-defining moves—all while injuries threaten to derail everything.


From the front office to the locker room,


Hometown Giants


delivers unfiltered access to the players, families, coaches, and owners navigating a season where NHL dreams hang in the balance and every shift could make or break a future.
